description: This file defines the Metrics interface, which provides methods for collecting and reporting various metrics related to device connections, telemetry messages, command messages, and processing durations within an IoT service platform. It includes methods for incrementing/decrementing connection counts, starting timers, and reporting message processing outcomes with associated metadata.

methods.name: incrementConnections
methods.description: Reports a newly established connection with an authenticated device, increasing the connection count for the specified tenant.

methods.name: decrementConnections
methods.description: Reports a connection to an authenticated device being closed, decreasing the connection count for the specified tenant.

methods.name: incrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Reports a new unauthenticated device connection.

methods.name: decrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Reports an unauthenticated device connection being closed.

methods.name: getNumberOfConnections
methods.description: Returns the total number of current connections, including authenticated and unauthenticated.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts and returns a new timer sample for measuring durations.

methods.name: reportTelemetry
methods.description: Reports the receipt and processing of a telemetry or event message from a device, with details about message type, tenant, outcome, QoS, payload size, optional TTD status, and processing time.

methods.name: reportCommand
methods.description: Reports a command or control message passed to or from a device, including direction, tenant, outcome, payload size, and processing duration.
